credits.title: Dark Beast
credits.overview: Oscuro animal tells the story of three women forced to flee their homes in a war torn region in Colombia.  Each of their journeys, marked by terror, takes them on a trek from the deep jungle to the outskirts of Bogotá, where they will gather new strength to start a new life.
